# Task
Resolve the following GitHub issue in this repository by editing the source code. Do not modify or add tests.

<issue>
Category/Tag/Author slugs are not settable
URLWrapper objects have a setter for their 'slug' property, but all of the concrete URLWrapper subclasses override the _getter_ for 'slug', which, because of the way Python's property accessors work, makes the setter inaccessible.  This breaks the 'category_meta' plugin and probably other things as well.
</issue>

559|     def attach_to(self, content):

563|         # Determine our file's new output path relative to the linking
564|         # document. If it currently lives beneath the linking
565|         # document's source directory, preserve that relationship on output.
566|         # Otherwise, make it a sibling.
567| 
568|         linking_source_dir = os.path.dirname(content.source_path)
569|         tail_path = os.path.relpath(self.source_path, linking_source_dir)
570|         if tail_path.startswith(os.pardir + os.sep):
571|             tail_path = os.path.basename(tail_path)
572|         new_save_as = os.path.join(
573|             os.path.dirname(content.save_as), tail_path)

576|         # document's url, because we cannot know just by looking at the latter
577|         # whether it points to the document itself or to its parent directory.

581|         # to figure it out by comparing the linking document's url and save_as
